newsitem.title: USA: Weyerhaeuser Q1 March 30 earnings summary.
newsitem.headline: Weyerhaeuser Q1 March 30 earnings summary.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

Note - 1997 Q1 net includes $25 million in extraordinary items from the anticipated consolidation, closure or disposition of certain recycling facilities, the completed permanent closure of the corrugated medium machine at Longview, Wash, and the sale of Shemin Nurseries, partly offset by interest income from a favorable federal income tax decision related to timber casualty losses in eruption of Mount St. Helens in 1980. Q197 EPS before special items were $0.22.
